title: Recover PR-003 handoff evidence integrity
objective: Correct PR-003 handoff schema, validator and fixtures so structured outcomes, exact local roots, Git/task bindings and typed precommit head evidence cannot be omitted or contradicted.
outcome: Every corrected PR-003 producer packet has independently auditable shape and truthful evidence references while historical producer receipts remain immutable.

commits.subject: Enforce structured PR-003 handoff evidence
commits.instructions: Require complete structured expected/observed command outcomes, explicit source locations and status-specific evidence in the handoff schema/checker.
commits.verification: Schema and checker fixtures reject missing, contradictory, duplicate and incomplete command/source/evidence records while accepting truthful expected-negative and unavailable outcomes.

commits.subject: Bind PR-003 evidence to exact local roots
commits.instructions: Verify task-binding, ledger, artifact, source, changed-file and Git paths against repoRoot with realpath containment and preserve a typed pending-head precommit convention.
commits.verification: Focused tests reject stale/unbound/cross-root/symlink references and invalid heads while accepting the exact f62 base binding.
